=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- File: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `_plan_files_section`, lines 557-562 (`if _PLAN_FILES_LEADIN_RE.match(line): ... continue`), consumed by `extract_plan_automation_paths` at lines 590-600
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The lead-in line that opens the Files section is never added to `kept`, and `extract_plan_automation_paths` scans only `kept`; a single-line form such as "Files likely to change: `scripts/security_audit.sh`" or "### Files to change: `.github/workflows/x.yml`" is therefore recognized as the section opener and its paths are dropped.
  WHY: If the next line is a heading at the same or shallower level, or the lead-in is the last line, the section is empty; the extractor returns no protected paths, `evaluate_plan_auto_approval` returns approve, and `plan.yml` or the poller posts `/approved`, even with `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED=false`.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: `_plan_auto_approval_hold_notify`, the block `if ! gh_retry gh api ".../comments" -f body="${hold_body}" ...; then echo "::warning::..."; return 0; fi` before `tg_notify_issue`
  severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failed hold-comment POST returns before `tg_notify_issue` runs.
  WHY: The plan stays held, but the Telegram WARNING meant to bring a maintainer in is not sent, so the issue sits in `ai:awaiting-approval` unnoticed.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: standalone `auto_approve` and `retrigger_implement` arms calling `_plan_auto_approval_gate_comments "${issue_num}" "${_candidate_details_json:-}"`
  severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: These arms re-fetch comment history even though `comments_json` is already in scope for the standalone path.
  WHY: When the batched cache is missing or holds 100 or more comments, the helper does an extra paginated REST read of `issues/<n>/comments`; a held standalone issue repeats it on every poll tick.
- File: changelog.d/6838-automation-path-plan-auto-approval.md
  Line or code reference: line 2, "With the flag off, auto-approval works exactly as before."
  severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: This pre-existing fragment is still present; it describes the #6838 hold-marker mechanism that this PR removes and says behavior with the flag off is unchanged.
  WHY: `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds both fragments into `CHANGELOG.md` at release, producing contradictory entries for the same variable and a stale description of the removed mechanism.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: file: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
  location: `_PLAN_PATH_TOKEN_RE` boundary class `[^A-Za-z0-9_./-]` (line 536)
  issue: `_` counts as an identifier character, so a path wrapped in underscore emphasis (`_scripts/x.sh_`) has no match and is not seen.
  suggested minimal fix: Drop `_` from the boundary class. The only effect is that more tokens match, so the gate holds more often (fail closed).
  estimated lines changed: 1
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 543-568 (`_plan_files_section`); 583-601 (`extract_plan_automation_paths`); 524-525 (`_PLAN_FILES_LEADIN_RE`); 535-537 (`_PLAN_PATH_TOKEN_RE`)
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Files ... change" lead-in line is matched but then skipped via `continue` without being added to `kept`; a protected path written on the same line as the lead-in is therefore invisible to the gate.
  WHY: `extract_plan_automation_paths` only scans `kept` (or the whole plan text when no section exists); the gate can approve the plan without holding it, even with the flag off and `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true`.
- File: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 535-537
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The path-token boundary class includes `_`, so a path preceded by an underscore or wrapped in underscores is not matched.
  WHY: A protected path can go undetected and the plan can be approved, breaking the fail-closed invariant.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: 15544-15548 (`_plan_auto_approval_hold_notify`)
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `gh_retry gh api .../comments` returns non-zero, the function logs a warning and returns 0 before calling `tg_notify_issue`.
  WHY: A maintainer who relies on Telegram notifications gets nothing when the comment POST fails, leaving the held plan without the intended alert.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: 19270-19271 and 19294-19297 (standalone `auto_approve` and `retrigger_implement` arms)
  severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Both arms call `_plan_auto_approval_gate_comments "${issue_num}" "${_candidate_details_json:-}"`, which falls through to `_staged_support_comments_for_guard`; the standalone caller already has `comments_json` in scope.
  WHY: When the GraphQL cache holds `comments_available=false` or `comments.json` holds 100+ items, the helper performs a fresh paginated REST read of `issues/<n>/comments` per stall-recovery attempt.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
